spans.s:
mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 An iron club or crow.
2 A lance.
E.
तु Sautra root, to hurt, affix विच्, तु that which injures, मृ to die, affix अच्, and the vowel of तु changed.

m. (-हः)
A warrior armed with a club.
E.
तोमर, and ग्रह who takes.

A warrior armed with a club.
E.
तोमर an iron club, and धर having.

f. (-का)
A fragrant earth: see तुवरिका.
